scope: Standalone actual LinuxIntel and LinuxIntelPAE mapping/read foundation

verification.make_check: 716 Rust tests and 45 reference harness tests passed; fmt, Clippy, release build, Windows compatibility inventory and contract audit passed

implementation: Linux32/LinuxPae accept PRESENT or PROT_NONE, reject Windows software swap semantics, mask intermediate table bases without inversion, clear large-page PAT before final PFN extraction, and apply the reference 32-bit register mask to final PFNs for both architectures.
evidence_correction: The earlier 49-case batch used generic Intel/IntelPAE classes. It established hardware paging geometry only and did not establish LinuxMixin behavior. The current fixture executes actual LinuxIntel/LinuxIntelPAE classes, including leaf/upper PROT_NONE, PROT_NONE large-page PAT, and PAE bit-32 cases.
limitations: Production Linux32 discovery and VirtualMemory routing are not connected; Linux four-byte-pointer ISFs remain rejected.
No full Linux32 plugin, process traversal or ELF32 reconstruction claim.
The two foundational kinds carry precise non-test dead-code expectations until discovery connects them.
Synthetic reference layers do not replace real 32-bit image and exact-symbol acceptance.
Linux64 still represents the existing generic Intel32e scanner baseline; this evidence does not establish LinuxIntel32e equivalence.
